Frequently asked questions

Can I edit the site myself?

Yes. When a CMS is part of the scope, you receive administrative access and training. A buildless site can be handed off as source files in your repository.

What if I need more pages or a custom feature?

Extra pages, content production, booking flows, integrations, and custom applications are quoted separately after scoping.

Who manages the website after launch?

You control the code and hosting account. You can operate the site yourself or arrange optional updates and technical maintenance.
